items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: By Benny Waters being in the band, we knew Benny

ctx.x: down on the floor. We walked up to the bandstand. By Benny Waters being in the band, we knew Benny, and we walked up and said, "Hey, Benny." And all three of them, the reed section, stood up and says, "Hi. Hi." I looked at Benny Waters... I don't know these other two Bennies, you know.
So they laughed. And Benny Waters introduced us to Ben Witt and Benny Carter. So it was funny. All three of them stood up when we said, "Hey, Benny!" But Benny didn't move me that night.
